functions.name: setSsbMode
functions.description: Mark/unmark an extension window with ssb-mode so userChrome (ssbChrome.css) renders it as a standalone app window.

functions.name: setSsbTabs
functions.description: Show/hide the tab strip in an SSB window by setting/removing the ssb-multi-tab attribute (ssbChrome.css shows the strip only when it is present).

functions.name: setPrefersColorScheme
functions.description: Override prefers-color-scheme for the selected tab of a window: dark, light, none (follow system), or auto (follow the chrome dark preference).

functions.name: getProfilePath
functions.description: Get the absolute path of the running profile's directory (ProfD) as {ok, path}. A --profile command line identifies a remote instance by profile path, so a generated .desktop entry needs this to relaunch in the profile that created it.

functions.name: isTaskbarAvailable
functions.description: Whether the compiled RozeLynxLinuxTaskbar XPCOM component (@bytewheel.org/pwa/linux-taskbar;1) is present, as {ok, available, error}. It is only built with USE=pwa on a GTK widget, so a caller can degrade once instead of per call.

functions.name: setWindowClass
functions.description: Set a window's WM_CLASS through the native taskbar component, which is what makes the window group under a launcher entry's StartupWMClass. Returns {ok} or {ok:false, error}.

functions.name: writeIconFile
functions.description: Decode a base64 image data: URL and write it to <profile>/pwa-icons/<fileName>, returning {ok, path, bytes}. The native icon setter takes a filesystem path for gdk-pixbuf, while a PWA's manifest icon is only available as a data: URL, so the parent process materialises it.

functions.name: setWindowIconFromPath
functions.description: Set a window's icon from a PNG/JPEG/... file on disk, through the native taskbar component. Returns {ok} or {ok:false, error}.

functions.name: writeDesktopEntry
functions.description: Write a PWA's generated .desktop entry to $XDG_DATA_HOME/applications (default ~/.local/share/applications), created if missing, mode 0644, UTF-8. A WebExtension has no filesystem API, so the parent does it. The name is sanitised to a file name, the .desktop suffix is forced, and content that does not start with [Desktop Entry] is refused. Returns {ok, path, name, bytes} or {ok:false, error}.

functions.name: removeDesktopEntry
functions.description: Delete a .desktop entry written by writeDesktopEntry from the same XDG applications directory. A file that is not there answers {ok:true, removed:false} rather than an error, so uninstalling twice is not a failure. Returns {ok, path, name, removed} or {ok:false, error}.

functions.name: hasDesktopEntry
functions.description: Report whether a PWA's generated .desktop entry exists in $XDG_DATA_HOME/applications, as {ok, path, name, exists}. This is the read half of writeDesktopEntry/removeDesktopEntry: a reconcile pass needs to know which installed apps still have no launcher entry, because the only other way to get one was to reinstall the app.

functions.name: ssbHandlerStatus
functions.description: Is the --ssb command-line handler (@mozilla.org/browser/ssb/clh;1) reachable? Gecko skips a registered handler silently when its contract cannot be created, so this asks for the service directly and returns the reason when it cannot.
